input.quote: (b) IN NO EVENT SHALL LICENSOR'S AGGREGATE CUMULATIVE TOTAL LIABILITY UNDER THIS AGREEMENT EXCEED ONE HALF OF THE AMOUNT PAID BY THE LICENSEE TO Licensor HEREUNDER.
input.rationale: Article XIII caps only Licensor's liability, and at one half of amounts paid — below the fallback's mutual 12 months' fees and squarely in walk-away territory (Licensor capped, Licensee uncapped and additionally exposed to a broad one-way indemnity in Article XII, with no super-cap). The consequential-damages exclusion in (a) likewise runs only in Licensor's favour, and there are no carve-outs for confidentiality, indemnification, gross negligence or wilful misconduct. Redline makes the cap and the damages exclusion mutual, sets the cap at the greater of 12 months' fees and USD 1,000,000, carves out Excluded Claims, and confirms our fee obligations are not capped damages; a straight mutual 12-month fee cap with indemnity/confidentiality/gross negligence/wilful misconduct carve-outs is the acceptable fallback.

proposal.summary: Make the liability cap and damages exclusion mutual, set the cap at the greater of 12 months' fees and USD 1,000,000, and carve out Excluded Claims.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We made the cap and the consequential-damages exclusion mutual and reset the cap to the greater of twelve months' fees and USD 1,000,000, since as drafted Licensor is capped at one half of amounts paid while our liability is unlimited. Indemnification, confidentiality/data-security, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement sit outside the cap, and our payment obligations are not capped damages; a straight mutual twelve-month fee cap is our fallback.

ops.oldText: IN NO EVENT SHALL LICENSOR BE LIABLE TO LICENSEE OR TO ANY THIRD PARTY FOR ANY SPECIAL, INDIRECT, INCIDENTAL OR CONSEQUENTIAL DAMAGES
ops.newText: EXCEPT FOR EXCLUDED CLAIMS, IN NO EVENT SHALL EITHER PARTY BE LIABLE TO THE OTHER PARTY FOR ANY SPECIAL, INDIRECT, INCIDENTAL OR CONSEQUENTIAL DAMAGES

ops.oldText: (b) IN NO EVENT SHALL LICENSOR'S AGGREGATE CUMULATIVE TOTAL LIABILITY UNDER THIS AGREEMENT EXCEED ONE HALF OF THE AMOUNT PAID BY THE LICENSEE TO Licensor HEREUNDER.
ops.newText: (b) EXCEPT FOR EXCLUDED CLAIMS, EACH PARTY'S AGGREGATE CUMULATIVE TOTAL LIABILITY ARISING OUT OF OR RELATING TO THIS AGREEMENT SHALL NOT EXCEED THE GREATER OF (I) THE FEES PAID OR PAYABLE BY LICENSEE UNDER THIS AGREEMENT IN THE TWELVE (12) MONTHS IMMEDIATELY PRECEDING THE EVENT GIVING RISE TO THE CLAIM AND (II) USD 1,000,000. "EXCLUDED CLAIMS" MEANS A PARTY'S BREACH OF ITS CONFIDENTIALITY, DATA PROTECTION OR SECURITY OBLIGATIONS, ITS INDEMNIFICATION OBLIGATIONS, ITS GROSS NEGLIGENCE, WILFUL MISCONDUCT OR FRAUD, AND ITS INFRINGEMENT OF THE OTHER PARTY'S INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY RIGHTS. LICENSEE'S OBLIGATION TO PAY FEES DUE UNDER THIS AGREEMENT SHALL NOT CONSTITUTE DAMAGES SUBJECT TO THIS CAP.
